Save and sign consent forms for patients.

    Form processing steps for now:
    * received POST with consent form
    1. save form
    2. parse patient data, get or create patient in current company
    3. bind form to patient
    4. add payment method for patient:
    * received POST with consent form signature data
    5. update form: add signature, change status (unsigned => signed), enable payment method

    We will void old unsigned forms after 1 hour of inactivity (change status to expired + remove card data)

post.description:
Create a new payment plan for a patient.

        There are two types of payment plans:
        1. `type: "standard"`. The standard post-service payment plan may be created only in case there is an outstanding
            patient balance. Standard payment plan checks the current patient balance on every installment and charges
            `installment` amount, but not more than the current balance of the patient.
            Payment plan also stops when the total installments sum reaches the "total_amount". The last installment in
            this case may be less than the `installment`. E.g. plan for `total_amount` of $100 and installment of $40
            the last installment amount is $20.

        2. type: "upfront". This is a pre-service payment plan. It does not check the current patient balance, may be
            started with any patient balance and will be charged up to a "total_amount".

        One of the `collectly_payment_method_id`, `external_payment_method_id` is required since
        payment plan requires a payment method. `external_payment_method_id` can be used only for patients that
        have `metadata.stripe_customer_id` set.
